dev: tsx has no dotenv loader, so the server reads PORT from the shell and it MUST equal VITE_SERVER_PORT — that is what exportFromPort wires up.

trap: a fresh worktree often serves a stale Vite dep cache, which makes koota's useWorld see a null React and blanks the whole Canvas behind the error boundary. Fix: rm -rf apps/client/node_modules/.vite and restart.
trap: unsmudged git-lfs ship models 404 and take the Canvas down the same way. Fix: git lfs pull.
trap: judge emissive/lateral surfaces from the REAL chase camera in /art-lab, not the /art-gallery orbit camera, where a side-facing glow is edge-on and reads as unlit even when correct.
herdr worktree create needs --workspace <parent repo workspace id> once any lane exists, else it fails with linked_worktree_source.
pane split --ratio is the share kept by the TOP pane; 0.8 = 80% agent / 20% stack.
Visual review uses claude-in-chrome (own tab per lane), never Playwright — the user and agent must watch the SAME live tab.

Lanes escalate decisions to the supervisor in a NEEDS-DECISION/OPTION/RECOMMENDATION block; supervisor puts them to the user via AskUserQuestion and relays back the REASONING, not just the verdict. Lanes never ask the user directly and never treat silence as approval.
